metadata.goal: Analyze pickup activity across local service areas during the workday.
metadata.header: LaDe 20: Aoi Service Periods And Courier Subregions
metadata.dataset_description: Constructed LaDe-style Shanghai pickup data: 220 tasks, 12 courier-days, 26141 GPS points. All times are local Shanghai time. Task destinations and GPS paths lie on the archived OSM street network; oneway directions are respected, while turn-restriction relations are not modeled. Moving GPS steps preserve all road vertices and have maximum spacing 45 m. speed_kmh and activity_state describe the immediately preceding segment. AOIs are explicitly constructed circular catchments within one constructed region, not original LaDe AOI polygons. Task events, service windows, couriers and assignments are constructed. accept_gps_time is the closest recorded GPS time to task acceptance; acceptance_distance_km uses interpolated position at the exact event time. Pickup GPS is recorded at the actual service-completion position. The last pickup is the observed end of each courier-day. Stationary waiting is retained in the GPS trace, but excluded from active_duration_hours, which sums travelling and servicing time. AOI visit intervals denote access-entry arrival through final pickup/service completion, not exact geometric boundary entry/exit; subsequent exit travel is recorded separately and is not counted as service.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def window_position(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    d=df.copy();start=pd.to_datetime(d.time_window_start,format='mixed');end=pd.to_datetime(d.time_window_end,format='mixed');pickup=pd.to_datetime(d.pickup_time,format='mixed')
    d['relative_position']=(pickup-start).dt.total_seconds()/(end-start).dt.total_seconds();groups=d.groupby('aoi_id')
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.8),constrained_layout=True)
    axes[0].boxplot([q.relative_position for _,q in groups],tick_labels=[a for a,_ in groups])
    axes[0].set(xlabel='AOI',ylabel='Relative pickup position: 0 = window start, 1 = end',ylim=(0,1),title='Same normalization across different window lengths')
    for aoi,q in groups:
        ordered=np.sort(q.relative_position);axes[1].step(ordered,np.arange(1,len(q)+1)/len(q),where='post',label=f'AOI {aoi} (n={len(q)})')
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Relative position inside the service window',ylabel='Cumulative fraction of pickups',title='AOI A is early-window; AOI B is late-window');axes[1].legend()
    return {'task_counts_by_aoi':groups.size().to_dict(),'median_relative_window_position':groups.relative_position.median().to_dict(),
            'within_window_share':float(d.relative_position.between(0,1).mean()),'daily_medians':d.groupby(['service_date','aoi_id']).relative_position.median().unstack().to_dict()}

evidence=window_position(df,user_df,supplement,aois)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
supplement=pd.read_csv("aoi_visits.csv")
aois=pd.read_csv("aois.csv")

def persistent_subregions(df,user_df,supplement,aois):
    stats={};fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,5.2),constrained_layout=True)
    for ax,(aoi,q) in zip(axes,df.groupby('aoi_id')):
        definition=aois.set_index('aoi_id').loc[aoi];center=np.array([definition.center_lng,definition.center_lat]);scale=np.array([95200,111000])
        daily=q.groupby(['service_date','courier_id'])[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].mean().reset_index()
        correct=[];shared=[]
        for day,heldout in q.groupby('service_date'):
            train=q[q.service_date.ne(day)].groupby('courier_id')[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].mean()
            x=heldout[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].to_numpy()*scale;centroids=train.to_numpy()*scale
            predicted=train.index.to_numpy()[np.linalg.norm(x[:,None]-centroids,axis=2).argmin(axis=1)]
            correct.extend(predicted==heldout.courier_id.to_numpy());sets=[]
            for courier in sorted(q.courier_id.unique()):
                gps=user_df[user_df.service_date.eq(day)&user_df.courier_id.eq(courier)]
                xy=(gps[['lng','lat']].to_numpy()-center)*scale;xy=xy[np.linalg.norm(xy,axis=1)<=definition.radius_m]
                sets.append(set(map(tuple,np.floor(xy/30).astype(int))))
            shared.append(len(sets[0]&sets[1]))
        separation=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(q.groupby('courier_id')[['pickup_lng','pickup_lat']].mean().to_numpy()*scale,axis=0)[0])
        for index,(courier,s) in enumerate(q.groupby('courier_id')):
            ax.scatter(s.pickup_lng,s.pickup_lat,s=18,alpha=.45,label=courier,color=['#548ca3','#c18355'][index])
            dc=daily[daily.courier_id.eq(courier)];ax.plot(dc.pickup_lng,dc.pickup_lat,'x--',lw=.8,color=['#548ca3','#c18355'][index])
        # GPS points near the access corridor expose the shared movement path.
        for courier,gps in user_df[user_df.service_date.eq(user_df.service_date.min())].groupby('courier_id'):
            xy=(gps[['lng','lat']].to_numpy()-center)*scale;mask=np.linalg.norm(xy,axis=1)<=definition.radius_m
            ax.scatter(gps.loc[mask,'lng'],gps.loc[mask,'lat'],s=1,alpha=.12,color='gray')
        visit=supplement[supplement.aoi_id.eq(aoi)&supplement.service_date.eq(supplement.service_date.min())].iloc[0]
        access=user_df[user_df.trajectory_id.eq(visit.trajectory_id)&user_df.route_section.eq(visit.visit_id)].copy()
        access=access[pd.to_datetime(access.gps_time,format='mixed')>=pd.Timestamp(visit.arrival_time)]
        branch=np.flatnonzero((abs(access.lng-definition.branch_lng)<1e-9)&(abs(access.lat-definition.branch_lat)<1e-9))[0]
        access=access.iloc[:branch+1]
        ax.plot(access.lng,access.lat,color='#263c3b',lw=2.4,zorder=4,label='Shared access road')
        ax.set(title=f'AOI {aoi}: pickup subregions and shared access GPS',xlabel='Longitude',ylabel='Latitude');ax.ticklabel_format(useOffset=False)
        ax.set_aspect(1/np.cos(np.radians(center[1])));ax.legend(fontsize=8)
        stats[aoi]={'leave_one_day_out_courier_classification_accuracy':float(np.mean(correct)),
            'courier_pickup_centroid_separation_m':float(separation),'daily_shared_30m_GPS_cells':shared,
            'days':q.service_date.nunique(),'couriers':q.courier_id.nunique()}
    return {'aoi_evidence':stats,'overlap_definition':'Shared 30-metre GPS grid cells inside each constructed AOI; a sampling-based overlap indicator, not an exact road length.'}

evidence=persistent_subregions(df,user_df,supplement,aois)
print(evidence)
plt.show()
